opening.argument: The title and narration place the subject firmly inside fictional GTA V gameplay: it identifies a supercar and race, while the speaker says, "welcome back to another gameplay video Today we're playing GTA V again." The described events remain in-game, including the race that begins with "So our race has started" and a frame showing multiple vehicles with the text "Race ended." The requests to share, support, subscribe, like, comment, and follow are ordinary audience-engagement prompts, presented without any link to financial participation or access to personal information. Nothing described turns the game's vehicles, missions, racing, or rewards into a real-world offer.
